packageRules.description: Vendored/pulled-in subcharts (Chart.lock, charts/*.tgz) are refreshed manually via `helm dependency update`, not by Renovate opening PRs against generated lockfiles.
Group all Helm chart + image tag bumps for a single app into one PR instead of one PR per field.
Security patch releases land immediately, not on the weekly schedule.

Nextcloud app image paused: all_squash on the NFS 'nas' StorageClass breaks the container's chown-based upgrade rsync on every version mismatch between image and PVC (CrashLoopBackOff, see argocd/apps/workloads/nextcloud/values.yaml and docs/3-apps-workloads/300b0-nextcloud.md#datenbank-major-upgrade-postgres-16--18). Re-enable once a safe upgrade path (e.g. S3/MinIO as primary storage) exists.
